summary.text: Mark Spencer is a Democrat who was elected to the Indiana Senate in 2024 and represents District 3, which includes Gary, Lake Station, New Chicago, Hobart, Ainsworth and Merrillville in Lake County.
He is Director of Fine Arts at Gary Community School Corporation.

paragraphs.text: According to his Indiana Senate Democrats biography, Spencer earned a Bachelor of Arts in theater from Indiana University, a Bachelor of Science in education from Calumet College of St. Joseph and a Master of Education from Indiana Wesleyan University.

He has been recognized by The Times of Northwest Indiana as one of its "Professionals to Watch," with the Katie Hall Educational Foundation's "Merit of Distinction Award" and with the Gary Frontiers Club's "Drum Major Award."
The page says he lives in Gary.
